goal: Avoid fee underestimation and errors by falling back to block policy when mempool estimates are unavailable
Ensures callers still receive valid fee rates when the mempool is sparse, loading, or unready
reviewability: Ready for review with no blockers or invalidating changes pending
agreement: Support for falling back to block policy to prevent fee errors downstream (achow101, instagibbs)
Simplified approach of erroring and falling back accepted after warmup removal (stickies-v)
Verified by testing that it resolves estimation issues on an unready mempool (tankyleo)
Nonblocking objection: falling back instead of flooring hurts legitimately quiet mempools (davidgumberg)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because it prevents severe fee underestimation or outright failures across fee estimation RPCs
Protects callers like LDK from missing estimates or stuck transactions when nodes restart or sync
